content: Roboɑmu
u bukurobun ɡɑri yinɑ
Roboɑmu u dɑ Sikɛmuɔ. Domi Isirelibɑ kpurowɑ bɑ dɑ mi, bu kɑ nùn ko sunɔ.
Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin bii u kpikiru suɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔ̃, u wɑ̃ɑ Eɡibitiɔ yerɑ u nuɑ mɑ Roboɑmu u bɑndu di. Yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u nɑ.
Ye u tunumɑ, mɑ wi kɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔkuru bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Roboɑmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
wunɛn tundo u sun yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ, mɑ yɑ sun buniɛ nɡe kɛtɛn suɡu. Adɑmɑ wunɛ ɑ sun tu kɑwo kpɑ su nun swĩi.
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ɡinɑ doo. Ǹ n kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ kpɑ i wurɑmɑ. Mɑ tɔn be, bɑ doonɑ.
Yerɑ Roboɑmu u Isirelibɑn bukurobu mɛnnɑ win mi, be bɑ rɑ rɑɑ win tundo Sɑlomɔɔ bwisi kɛ̃, u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bwisi yirɑ̀ i mɑn kɛ̃mɔ n tɔn be sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n wurɑ sɑɑ ɡisɔn di, ɑ tɔn be nɔɔri kpɑ ɑ ko ye bɑ nun bikiɑ, kpɑ ɑ bu wisi kɑ kĩru, bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn tɔmbu sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Adɑmɑ Roboɑmu wi, u ǹ bukuro ben ɡɑri wure. Win sɑɑrɑsi kɑ be u biru di sɑnnu, berɑ u bwisi bikiɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bwisi yirɑ̀ i mɑn kɛ̃mɔ n kɑ tɔn be wisi be bɑ nɛɛ, n bù yoo sɔmɑ kɑwo ye nɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu koosiɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, wunɛn nikibii piibu ɡɑ wunɛn tundon pɔrɑ bɔɔrum kere.
Wunɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ. Mɛyɑ kɑɑ mɑɑ tu sosi. Wunɛn tundo u rɑɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ yii sɛnnu, mɛyɑ kɑɑ mɑɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ som kpɑki.
Yerɑ Yeroboɑmu kɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ nɑ Roboɑmun mi sɔ̃ɔ itɑse ye, nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ.
Roboɑmu u tɔn be wisɑ kɑ dɑm, u ǹ bukuro ben bwisi yi ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu.

Adɑmɑ win sɑɑrɑsi ben bwisiyɑ u kɑ sɔmburu kuɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn tundo u rɑɑ bɛɛ yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ. Adɑmɑ tɛ̃, nɛɡirɑ tɑ koo kerɑ. U rɑɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ yii sɛnnu. Adɑmɑ nɛ, som kpɑkiyɑ kon kɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Roboɑmu u yinɑ u tɔn beɡii swɑɑ dɑki domi Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u derɑ n kuɑ mɛ, kpɑ win ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ, ye u Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin bii sɔ̃ɔwɑ sɑɑ Akiyɑ Siloɡiin nɔɔn di.
Isirelibɑn bɑndɑ bɔnu kuɑ
yiru
Ye Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ wɑ mɑ sinɑ boko u ǹ ben ɡere swɑɑ dɑki, yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: mbɑ n sun mɔɔsinɛ bɛsɛ kɑ Dɑfidi Isɑin bii.
Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ bɔnu ɡɑɑ mɔ kɑ wi.
Bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ i de su ɡɔsirɑ bɛsɛn yɛnusɔ.
Wunɛ Roboɑmu ɑ wunɛn bweserun wunɑnɔ koowo.

content: Mɑ Isireli be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ ben yɛnusɔ.
Mɑ Roboɑmu u kuɑ Yudɑn bweseru tɔnɑn sunɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ u Adorɑmu ɡɔrɑ Isirelibɑn mi, wi u rɑ bu kpɑre bu kɑ yoo sɔmɑ ko. Mɑ bɑ nùn kpenu kɑsukɑ bɑ ɡo. Yerɑ n derɑ Roboɑmun tii, u win tɑbu kɛkɛ wɔri fuuku fuuku u dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔku te, tɑ kɑ Dɑfidin yɛnuɡibu kɑrɑnɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.

Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ nuɑ mɑ Yeroboɑmu u wurɑmɑ sɑɑ Eɡibitin di, yerɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nùn sokusiɑ. Ye u nɑ, yerɑ bɑ nùn kuɑ ben sunɔ. Yudɑn bweseru bɑɑsi, ɡoo sɑri wi u mɑɑ kɑ Dɑfidin bweseru yɔ̃rɑ.

Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Roboɑmu u tunumɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, yerɑ u Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ. Mɑ u be sɔɔ tɑbu durɔ dɑmɡibu nɔrɔbun subɑ ɡoobu yɛndu sɑri (180.000) ɡɔsɑ bu dɑ bu Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔku te wɔri, kpɑ bu bɑn te wɔrɑmɑ bu nùn wesiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ win sɔmɔ Semɑyɑ ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ Roboɑmu Sɑlomɔɔn bii Yudɑbɑn sunɔ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɔ,

ɑ nɛɛ, wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Bu ku rɑɑ dɑ bu kɑ ben mɛro bisibu Isirelibɑ tɑbu ko. Ben bɑɑwure u ɡɔsiro win yɛnuɔ, domi yeni yɑ nɑwɑ sɑɑ nɛ Yinni Gusunɔn min di. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere wurɑ, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ wurɑ ben yɛnusɔ.
Yeroboɑmu u wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Sikɛmu ɡbɑ̃rɑru toosi ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuurun berɑ ɡiɑ. Mɑ u sinɑ mi. Yen biru u yɑrɑ min di u dɑ u Penuɛli ɡbɑ̃rɑru toosi.
Yeroboɑmu
u Gusunɔn swɑɑ deri

Yerɑ Yeroboɑmu u bwisikɑ u nɛɛ, tɔn be, bɑ̀ n dɑɑmɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ yɑ̃kuru ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, nɛn bɑn te nɑ dii mi, tɑ koo rɑ wurɑ Dɑfidin bweseru sɔɔ. Domi ben lɑɑkɑri yɑ koo wurɑ ben yinni Roboɑmun mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ ben sunɔ. Kpɑ bu mɑn ɡo bu wɑ bu kɑ wurɑ win mi.
Ye Yeroboɑmu u bwisi bikiɑ bikiɑ, yerɑ u kɛtɛn bwɑ̃ɑrokunu yiru kuɑ kɑ wurɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Isirelibɑ nɑ bɛɛ wɑsirɑru wɑɑwɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun dɑɑbu. Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛn yinni wee mini wi u bɛɛ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di.
Mɑ u ɡen teu yi Betɛliɔ, teu mɑɑ Dɑnuɔ.
Mɑ yeni yɑ kuɑ yinɑ ye yɑ bu sure durum sɔɔ, domi bɑ rɑ n dɑɑmɔwɑ Betɛliɔ ǹ kun mɛ Dɑnuɔ bɑ n bwɑ̃ɑroku ni sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Yerɑ Yeroboɑmu u sɑ̃ɑ yenu bɑnɑ ɡunɡunu wɔllɔ. Yen biru u yɑ̃ku kowobu ɡɔsɑ be bɑ kun sɑ̃ɑ Lefin bweseru.

Yeroboɑmu u tɔ̃ru burɑ bu kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ko wɔ̃ɔn suru nɔɔbɑ itɑsen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔ, nɡe mɛ Yudɑbɑ bɑ rɑ ko. Mɑ u dɑ Betɛliɔ u yɔɔwɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ u bwɑ̃ɑroku ni yɑ̃kuru koosi. Mɑ u yɑ̃ku kowo be u ɡɔsɑ yi Betɛli mi.
Yeroboɑmun yɑ̃ku yee te,
tɑ ǹ kɑ Gusunɔ nɑɑwɛ
Ye tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ turɑ te Yeroboɑmu u burɑ mi, yerɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di Betɛliɔ. Mɑ win tii u yɔɔwɑ yɑ̃ku yerɔ, u turɑre dɔ̃ɔ doke.
